evals.name: cluster-safe-multikey
evals.prompt: Perform a multi-key MGET or transaction in a Valkey Cluster environment without triggering CROSSSLOT errors.
evals.expected_output: Using hash tags '{tenant_id}:key' to ensure multi-key operations land on the exact same cluster hash slot.
assertions: Uses Valkey hash tags (curly braces) in key naming (e.g. '{tenant1}:profile' and '{tenant1}:settings').
Guarantees that related keys hash to the identical slot.
Prevents CROSSSLOT Keys in request don't hash to the same slot error.

evals.name: handle-cluster-redirection
evals.prompt: How does valkey-go handle MOVED and ASK redirection errors during cluster slot migration?
evals.expected_output: Explanation and configuration of valkey-go automatic routing and topology refresh.
assertions: Configures valkey-go cluster client with initial seed addresses.
Explains that valkey-go handles MOVED redirection by updating internal slot routing table.
Explains that ASK redirection is transparently handled with ASKING command to target node.

evals.name: cluster-topology-refresh
evals.prompt: A master node in a Valkey cluster fails and a replica is promoted. How does the Go client maintain availability?
evals.expected_output: Configuring periodic and on-error cluster topology refresh in valkey-go.
assertions: Enables automatic topology refresh in cluster client options.
Refreshes slot mapping when connection errors or redirections occur.
Maintains request availability during node failover.
